updates.new_facts: Corvani was 25 years younger than Victor and Stitch. He was saved by Stitch from a burned slum when he was a young agent. His former codename was Whale, derived from an ocean incident where a whale stuck to their Navy ship fan and he calmly swam out, freed it, and fell asleep with a cigar in his mouth. He opposed Stitch's ideology and left ECAP around 2005 when Victor's son died. He got trapped in a pocket dimension where he met Aeric Valenheart and lost an eye fighting Alter David. In 2025, he and Aeric learned to escape the pocket dimension, met Zaan, and returned to the ocean where his rescued whale saved a falling Ethan.

timeline_events.title: Corvani's Navy Whale Incident
timeline_events.description: During a scouting mission on a Navy ship, Marcello Corvani calmly jumped into the water and manually removed a whale stuck to the outer fan of the ship, earning his former codename 'Whale'.
